Profile Tolperisone hydrochloride is a centrally acting muscle relaxant that has been used for the symptomatic treatment of spasticity (p.1887) and muscle spasm (p.1887), in usual doses of 50 to 150 mg three times daily by mouth. It has also been given by injection.
